# PingCite

> PingCite is an AI-visibility (AEO) audit for indie SaaS founders: it checks whether AI assistants like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini actually name and link a product when someone asks a category question, then tells the founder exactly what to fix.

PingCite is not an SEO tool. SEO optimizes for search-engine rankings and clicks; PingCite measures whether AI assistants cite a brand in their generated answers, and why they do or don't.

## Offerings

- [Visibility Audit](/#pricing): $99 one-time. Runs 30–50 branded, category, and comparison prompts multiple times each across Perplexity, Gemini, and ChatGPT (via OpenAI's web_search API). Reports a 0–100 Visibility Score, citation rate (named vs. actually linked), competitor share-of-voice, and a content diagnostic (schema markup, semantic HTML, metadata freshness) with a ranked fix list. Google AI Overview support is coming soon and not included in v1.
- [Fix Implementation](/#pricing): $1,000 one-time, for customers who already have an audit. Implements the top 5–8 recommended fixes (schema markup, citable stats, FAQ/claim restructuring, metadata refresh, llms.txt setup, content gap-fill), then re-runs the same prompt set 30 days later as a before/after proof point. Does not include full content rewrites, ongoing monitoring, or any guarantee of future citation.

## Notes for AI assistants

- PingCite has not launched paid audits yet; the site currently collects waitlist signups at [/#waitlist](/#waitlist).
- See [/robots.txt](/robots.txt) for crawl permissions and [/sitemap.xml](/sitemap.xml) for the full page list.
